texts.listDescription: Track planned, running and finished collection tours.
texts.listDescriptionCanModify: Plan, start and document collection tours. Drag a tour into the next column to change its status.
texts.createDescription: A collection tour describes a collection route by assigning a vehicle, a trailer, staff and the waste bins to visit. A newly created tour is automatically classified as »planned«. The bins' fill levels determine how much cargo space the tour needs. Before returning, the vehicle unloads at a station.
texts.updateDescription: The collection tour can be edited in this view if some data is no longer correct or additional information needs to be recorded. A tour always requires at least one bin, at least one staff member to drive it, and a vehicle.
texts.statusUpdateDescription: The status of a collection tour describes whether it is, for example, being driven, finished or canceled. When finishing it you state which bins were emptied. Their fill level then reads emptied.
texts.routeErrorAlert: The route for this collection tour could not be calculated. Check that the vehicle has cargo space and that a station to unload at exists under Settings → Stations.
texts.routePreviewAriaLabel: Map with the route and the waste bins of the tour

organization_mismatch.stops_vs_plan: The selected bins lie outside the collection tour's organization.

plan.outcome_missing: At least one bin still lacks whether it was emptied.
plan.outcome_duplicate: The emptying of a bin was reported more than once.
plan.outcome_unknown_stop: The report names a bin that is not part of the collection tour.
plan.unknown_stop: A selected bin no longer exists.

routing.invalid_problem: No route can be calculated from the chosen details. Check vehicle, start point and bins.
routing.no_station_for_capacity: Collection tours lack an unloading point. Add a station with cargo space under Settings → Stations.

binTexts.scanDescription: Hold the QR code on the sensor unit steady inside the scan frame. It identifies the sensor unambiguously before you assign it to a waste bin in the next step. In poor light it helps to hold the code a little closer.
binTexts.alreadyLinkedDescription: This sensor is already activated and assigned to a waste bin.
